_experiment.scientific_factor: R09 + only design-region factored smooth-lDDT (0.1): standard MF/Boltz 0.5/1/2/4A smooth score with 15A protein cutoff, factored per complex into design-design, design-fixed-scaffold and design-antigen relations. Same-residue and context-context pairs are excluded; the supplied design mask makes the implementation H3-, 6CDR- and generic-design-region compatible.
r05_invariants: legacy R05 sequence path and per-round CE semantics

representation_semantics.single: explicit local single state s_i = projected R05 hidden + corrected 4-head residue-atom attention over canonical atom slots + flow-time + role + PCS-RC proposal condition + detached recurrent single state
representation_semantics.pair: proposal-anchored triangle-closed local z_ij over every design/paratope residue plus the nearest 18 PCS-RC antigen-context residues; learned relative position, current/proposal CA geometry, and slot-resolved canonical atom14xatom14 Gaussian geometry are retained before compression; native H3 AA-pair identity is excluded to prevent target leakage
representation_semantics.graph_integration: final triangle-refined z_ij is gathered onto the existing R05 dynamic local/surface EGNN edges and projected by a zero-start residual into the SAME invariant edge message consumed by both the original node_model and coord_model; this is the R05 analogue of AbX final pair -> IPA structure consumption and introduces no second coordinate decoder
representation_semantics.sequence_integration: legacy R05 sequence logits are read from post-EGNN H, so final pair information reaches sequence through the structure trunk; an additional zero-start enriched-single -> 20-AA logits residual preserves the proven parent while testing direct amino-acid-discriminative information
representation_semantics.coordinate_decoder: original R05 equivariant coordinate engine remains the only coordinate decoder
representation_semantics.coordinate_units: R05 model-frame coordinates are scaled by 0.1, so representation geometry RBF centers use 0.2-2.2 model units corresponding to physical 2-22 A; distogram labels remain physical 2-22 A on native coordinates
representation_semantics.pair_reasoning: one no-MSA closed block: AbX-style OPM supplies single->pair communication; then MF Pairformer ordering applies triangle multiplication out/in, triangle attention start/end, pair transition, and finally pair-biased single attention + single transition. Thus each block is single -> pair -> relational reasoning -> single in the same R05 round.
representation_semantics.recycling: detached s/z representation-state carry only across the existing three evolving R05 physical rounds; this is explicitly not MF fixed-input latent recycling. No nested recycle loop and no derived previous-clean history summary.
representation_semantics.triangle_autograd: Triangle/OPM mathematics unchanged; only re-entrant activation checkpointing is disabled under torch1.11 DDP. Dynamic used-parameter discovery is enabled because the triangle-to-loss route can be batch-dependent through dynamic R05 EGNN edges and detached recycle.
representation_semantics.allatom_geometry: AbX-semantic slot-resolved atom14xatom14 distance field: 196 canonical atom-slot Gaussian features with trainable slot-pair coefficients are chunked and compressed; unlike AbX, coefficients are not conditioned on native H3 AA-pair identity, avoiding sequence-target leakage.
representation_semantics.atom_level: R09 adds one task-scale pair-conditioned atom attention block. It transfers the MF AtomAttentionEncoder semantic z->atom-pair attention while using AbFlow canonical atom14 embeddings/geometry instead of incompatible Boltz charge/element/name features. The block is representation-only; R05 EGNN remains the sole coordinate engine.

formal_runtime.validation: exact DDP logical-batch sharding with EMA
formal_runtime.ddp_batch_partition: cost-balanced within each shuffled global batch; preserves global batch sample multiset and 28 samples/rank while balancing whole-residue + local-token^3 compute/memory proxy
formal_runtime.triangle_local_universe: all design residues + up to 18 PCS-RC-nearest antigen residues per complex; dense/triangle-closed only inside this bounded local set
formal_runtime.ddp_graph_contract: torch1.11 dynamic graph: triangle activation checkpoint off; DDP static_graph off; find_unused_parameters on

observability: run_time.log: canonical human-readable tmux/stdout/stderr stream; includes only mechanism diagnostics needed for R05×MF analysis
ValidationPhysical: validation H3 CA raw/aligned, native-contact F1 and CAAR
R05RoundAudit: per-round H3 CA raw/aligned and AAR across the original three R05 rounds

MFRepresentationAudit: single/pair RMS, local-token/pair counts, atom14-pair geometry RMS, OPM and exact triangle update RMS, zero-start adapter magnitude, recurrent single/pair delta, pair-conditioned atom refinement, distogram and design-region factored smooth-lDDT
SequenceForensic: CE/AAR, posterior entropy/max probability/MAP collapse statistics and proposal agreement
ValidationPhysicalBins: count-weighted H3 CA raw RMSD in five flow-time bins

epoch_summary.csv: epoch + train/validation formal loss components + seven core Test metrics + train/val distogram/smooth-lDDT + all-time minimum-validation matched Test metrics

loss_hierarchy.rationale: R05 parent losses remain unchanged. Design-region factored smooth-lDDT retains the MF/Boltz metric but normalizes design-design, design-fixed-scaffold and design-antigen relations separately per complex, excluding same-residue and context-context pairs. This prevents pair-count and canonical-local-geometry domination from H3 to 6CDR. Weight 0.1 keeps it a weak rigid-motion-invariant geometry regularizer, not a second transport authority.

_experiment.representation_fidelity: v164 task-consistent donor fusion: AbX OPM supplies single->pair communication; MF pair-first Pairformer supplies refined pair->single readback; final z conditions the sole R05 EGNN mechanics. Optional pair-conditioned atom reasoning adapts MF/AF3 z->atom semantics without an AF3 decoder. Optional design-region factored smooth-lDDT is H3/6CDR-generic. No MSA/ESM, native design-AA leakage, IPA/AF3 second coordinate authority, EDM sampler or nested fixed-input recycle.
_experiment.runtime_bugfix: Pair-conditioned atom refinement uses the exact bounded triangle-closed pair-universe token order recovered from pair_edges; full local antigen context outside that universe is left unchanged. This fixes the v163 44^2-vs-74^2 contract bug without changing the scientific factor.
